From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps & demo scheduling

Hi Julia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to hear more about Ava's ingestion pipeline and the evaluation goals for reducing inference cost on doc search. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Goal: proof-of-concept for reranking/semantic search over 1.5M docs; target latency P95 < 300ms
- Next step: technical deep dive + demo with our Solutions Engineer (Michael) to go over integration + quantization/throughput tradeoffs

Can you confirm availability for a 45-min technical deep dive next week? Two windows that work for our team:
- Tue 2026-02-26, 11:00 AM EST / 8:00 AM PST
- Wed 2026-02-27, 2:00 PM EST / 11:00 AM PST

I intended to send a calendar invite with the meeting link but I realize I may not have actually attached it — apologies if you didn't receive it. Proposed meeting URL: https://meet.redwood.ai/abc123 (placeholder — I'll send a formal invite once you confirm a slot).

I've attached the discovery notes from today's call for reference.

Attachments: discovery-notes-avasolutions.pdf (summary + open questions)

Thanks — please confirm which slot works and your timezone preference and I'll send the invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
